name: Brave Search MCP
description: Official MCP server for the Brave Search API. Exposes web search and local business search as callable tools, returning structured results with titles, URLs, and snippets.

doc_quality.notes: Clear README with setup steps, environment variable docs, and example outputs. Missing schema definitions for response objects.

auth_security.notes: API key passed via environment variable — standard and safe. No credential rotation guidance or scoped-key documentation.

tool_coverage.notes: Two tools exposed: brave_web_search and brave_local_search. Covers core use cases but lacks image search, news search, and autocomplete.

reliability.notes: Error messages are descriptive and include HTTP status codes. Rate-limit handling documented. Upstream Brave API SLA applies.

community.notes: Maintained in the official MCP servers monorepo by Anthropic. Active issue tracker, regular commits, and included in Claude Desktop by default.
